concept.title: Check account eligibility for single sign-on (SSO) integration
concept.shortdesc: Existing Red Hat users can authenticate to Red Hat with their company single sign-on credentials when their company SSO is integrated with Red Hat SSO.

conbody.p: You can integrate your identity provider with Red Hat SSO by using the self-service identity provider integration support.
Self-service SSO integration is supported for the following Red Hat account types:

ul.li: A Red Hat Corporate account type with an active, non-evaluation subscription.
An approved Red Hat partner account type.

conbody.note: Personal account types are not supported.
